sources.snippet: MARTI supports centralized multi-agent interactions and distributed policy training, with the added capability of multi-turn asynchronous rollouts to enhance training efficiency. The framework includes dynamic workflows for multi-agent interactions, which integrate both rule-based verifiable rewards and LLM-based generative rewards.

sources.snippet: MARTI is an open-source framework for training LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) with Reinforcement Learning (RL). It enables powerful, scalable, and adaptive workflows by combining centralized multi-agent interactions with distributed policy training.

sources.title: MARTI: Multi-Agent RL Framework for LLM Training and Inference
sources.snippet: A review of TsinghuaC3I/MARTI, an MIT-licensed Python framework for LLM multi-agent reinforcement learning, covering its centralized interaction model, MARTI-v2 tree search features, installation path, limitations and alternatives.
